ne684ac94472.s: India's Look East Policy (1991) was upgraded to the Act East Policy in:
ne684ac94472.x: Look East (1991) became Act East in 2014, focusing on ASEAN, Japan and South Korea.

n1df4e491865.s: India's policy focusing on energy and diaspora links with the Gulf and West Asia is called:
n1df4e491865.x: Gulf and West Asia energy and diaspora ties are the focus of Link West; Act East looks to ASEAN, Japan and South Korea.

ncf93fcc6243.s: Which of the following was held along with MILAN 2026 at Visakhapatnam in February 2026?
ncf93fcc6243.x: MILAN 2026 was held with IFR 2026 and the IONS Conclave at Visakhapatnam; DOSTI-16 was not part of these events.

n48cb1e24b8d.s: In September 2026, Israel shut which country's Jerusalem consulate after it banned trade with illegal Israeli settlements?
n48cb1e24b8d.x: The UK (with France and Canada) banned trade with illegal Israeli settlements, and Israel responded by shutting Britain's Jerusalem consulate.

ncace95eef89.s: The 36 Rafale jets of the Indian Air Force were bought under the deal of:
ncace95eef89.x: The 36 IAF Rafales came under the 2016 deal, not 2019; the 114 MRFA jets got AoN in February 2026.

n84c6e917c1b.s: India's Kalvari-class (Scorpene) submarines are based on the technology of:
n84c6e917c1b.x: The Kalvari-class Scorpene submarines use French Naval Group technology and are built at MDL; Italy's WASS supplies their torpedoes.

n881c5e4846a.s: Amid the 2026 West Asia crisis, India deployed which Navy escort missions?
n881c5e4846a.x: India deployed the Navy escort missions Sankalp and Urja Suraksha around Hormuz; it did not join the US–Israel attacks on Iran.

nb1984c5f27b.s: Under the GE F414 engine deal, which manufacturing process remains with the United States?
nb1984c5f27b.x: The single-crystal blade process stays with the US, which limits technology transfer and keeps India dependent.

na5789370584.s: The Quad comprises India, the United States, Japan and:
na5789370584.x: The Quad is India, the US, Japan and Australia; it has no Quad-level 2+2, though bilateral 2+2s exist among all four.

na1aa6d7385f.s: How many Kalvari-class Scorpene submarines does India's P-75 programme comprise?
na1aa6d7385f.x: P-75 comprises six Kalvari-class submarines; the last, INS Vaghsheer, was delivered in 2025.

ca9d25e68c980d.s: In 2021, ISRO invited proposals for a Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator of what power?
ca9d25e68c980d.x: ISRO sought proposals in 2021 for a 100-watt RTG.

ca278c2b358b3d.s: TAPAS-1 was planned for a 500-km sun-synchronous orbit with a mission life of:
ca278c2b358b3d.x: TAPAS-1, launched on the Falcon 9 Transporter-18 rideshare, was planned for a 500-km SSO with a 3-year life.

ca3da5afc7a1ac.s: Which French firm is the launch-services partner for TakeMe2Space's orbital data-centre mission?
ca3da5afc7a1ac.x: French firm RIDE! Space is TakeMe2Space's launch partner; Safran partnered Dhruva Space and U-Space partnered AXISCADES.

caaeb7a6b1f905.s: Telangana's 5 GW hyperscale data-centre target is linked to an AI and digital investment opportunity of about:
caaeb7a6b1f905.x: The 5 GW goal (for 2029) is linked to an opportunity of about USD 30 billion.

caebf09bb4f26f.s: GalaxEye's patented OptoSAR system synchronises which two kinds of sensors?
caebf09bb4f26f.x: OptoSAR syncs optical and Synthetic Aperture Radar sensors to image at the same time; the patent is a US one.

caeac9c77ac1aa.s: The SPROUT phenotyping facility inaugurated in September 2026 is located at:
caeac9c77ac1aa.x: SPROUT was inaugurated at BRIC–NIPGR, New Delhi, in September 2026.

ca5ddb341c9f97.s: Agnikul Cosmos, established in 2017, developed which small-satellite launcher?
ca5ddb341c9f97.x: Agnikul Cosmos (2017, IIT Madras-incubated) developed Agnibaan; Vikram-1 is Skyroot's and Rumi-1 Space Zone India's.

ca4cd229e60a16.s: In Homi Bhabha's three-stage nuclear programme, the third stage uses:
ca4cd229e60a16.x: The programme runs PHWR (natural uranium) → FBR (plutonium) → U-233 from Th-232 in the third stage.

ca9516d86596bd.s: DRDO's indigenous High-Altitude Platform System, a stratospheric airship, uses solar power and:
ca9516d86596bd.x: The HAPS uses solar power and helium (not hydrogen); it reached 21 km and stayed stable at 20 km for over 30 minutes.

cab172512551f5.s: Which instrument makes the launching State absolutely liable for damage caused by its space object on Earth?
o: UN Principles on Nuclear Power Sources, 1992
cab172512551f5.x: The Liability Convention (1972) sets absolute liability; the ban on nuclear weapons in orbit is in the Outer Space Treaty.

ca6cb2cd2f12f8.s: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) can image through clouds and at night because it:
o: senses thermal infrared emitted by the surface
sends microwaves and records their echoes
uses visible-light cameras with long exposure
ca6cb2cd2f12f8.x: SAR is active remote sensing: it sends microwaves and records the echoes, so it works through clouds and at night.

cad6e4190b620b.s: Samarthak is the first of how many Multi-Purpose Vessels being built for the Indian Navy?
cad6e4190b620b.x: Samarthak is the first of four MPVs, with surveillance, patrol, target-deployment and unmanned-support roles.

ca1161937231b0.s: TROUT, the first indigenous military-grade underwater ROV delivered to the Indian Navy, is made by:
ca1161937231b0.x: Kerala start-up EyeROV makes TROUT; it has delivered 2 of the 5 ordered.

cacfcb2cfb0cfe.s: Which Indian ships took part in AIME-2026, the 2nd ASEAN–India Maritime Exercise?
cacfcb2cfb0cfe.x: India sent INS Sahyadri and INS Kulish to AIME-2026 at Subic Bay, which ran a Harbour phase followed by a Sea phase.

cac8da3e5ee045.s: The Indian contingent at KAZIND-2026 was drawn mainly from:
o: 9 Gorkha Rifles and the Indian Navy
Bhairav Battalion and the Indian Air Force
Garhwal Rifles and the Indian Navy
Garhwal Rifles and the Indian Air Force
cac8da3e5ee045.x: The 60-member Indian contingent came mainly from the Garhwal Rifles and the IAF.

ca2c33ffba3b0a.s: The first edition of the multinational air exercise Tarang Shakti was held in:
ca2c33ffba3b0a.x: Tarang Shakti's first edition was in 2024; the 2026 edition had aircraft from 8 countries and 32 observers.

ca947b5d464b03.s: Dharma Guardian is the India–Japan exercise of which service?
ca947b5d464b03.x: Dharma Guardian is the India–Japan army exercise; JIMEX is the naval one.

caadf23615f30a.s: The 2026 India–France space-industry agreements followed whose visit to India in February 2026?
caadf23615f30a.x: The agreements followed President Emmanuel Macron's India visit in February 2026; India–France space ties date from the 1960s.

ca53e32d786610.s: While India received only Dialogue Partner status in GCAP, it continues its own fifth-generation fighter programme called:
ca53e32d786610.x: India is a GCAP Dialogue Partner, not a member, and continues the fifth-generation AMCA.

ca95bff34f7815.s: As of September 2026, how many supercomputers had been built under the National Supercomputing Mission?
ca95bff34f7815.x: NSM (April 2015) had 40 supercomputers with 68 petaFLOPS as of September 2026; 50 systems is the target.

ca88592adfb86f.s: IIT Hyderabad signed MoUs on exchanges and semiconductor research with which Japanese university?
ca88592adfb86f.x: IIT Hyderabad and Mie University signed MoUs on student and faculty exchange and semiconductor research.

cac7721edcd91a.s: Under the National Supercomputing Mission, the indigenous Rudra servers were designed by:
cac7721edcd91a.x: C-DAC designed the Rudra servers; the National Knowledge Network is the backbone and makes no servers.

caeb4509b916f4.s: India's first IIT, IIT Kharagpur, was established in:
caeb4509b916f4.x: IIT Kharagpur was established in 1951, not 1952.

cac80a0bffa73f.s: IIT Madras estimated that reusing rocket parts could cut manufacturing cost by up to:
cac80a0bffa73f.x: IIT Madras estimated reuse could cut rocket manufacturing cost by up to 80%.

cafb96dde6fa59.s: The AlphaGenome Atlas, launched by Google DeepMind on 8 September 2026, has AI predictions for about how many single-letter mutations?
cafb96dde6fa59.x: It holds predictions for about 9 billion single-letter mutations; the genome itself is about 3 billion base pairs.

ca45e40d0b7166.s: Bio-Nivesh, a platform linking biotech start-ups with investors, was launched by:
ca45e40d0b7166.x: Dr Jitendra Singh launched Bio-Nivesh to connect biotech start-ups with investors.

ca507e72c6e608.s: GSLV Mk II can place about how much payload into Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit?
ca507e72c6e608.x: GSLV Mk II carries about 2,250 kg to GTO and 6,000 kg to LEO; its indigenous cryogenic stage dates from GSLV-D5 (January 2014).

ca89051f389059.s: Under NM-ICPS, the Technology Translation Research Park for cybersecurity is at:
ca89051f389059.x: IIT Kanpur handles cybersecurity; IISc covers robotics and AI, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad mining and IIT Indore digital healthcare.

ca90513bc2db30.s: ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan was decommissioned on 27 August 2026 at:
ca90513bc2db30.x: ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan was decommissioned at Mumbai; ICGS Meera Behn at Okha and ICGS Savitribai Phule at Karwar.

ca8973381c9c1c.s: IIT Madras was established in 1959 with aid from:
ca8973381c9c1c.x: IIT Madras was set up in 1959 with West German aid.

ca8097f45bb798.s: Which orbit is necessarily circular, equatorial and of zero inclination?
ca8097f45bb798.x: A geostationary orbit is circular, equatorial and untilted; a geosynchronous orbit can be elliptical or inclined.

ca8e6ddc92550c.s: The SHANTI Act enables small modular reactors and:
ca8e6ddc92550c.x: The SHANTI Act allows small modular reactors and micro reactors, not fusion reactors.

ca11c0c2537414.s: The recombinant cobra antivenom of IISc and the Technical University of Denmark was made from antibodies of:
ca11c0c2537414.x: The recombinant antivenom uses camelid (llama) antibodies; conventional antivenom is raised in horses.

cna496aa5f7c01.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's TB Mukt Bharat progress?
o: India's new TB incidence fell by 21% between 2015 and 2024
Global TB incidence fell by 12% in the same period
The PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan was launched on 9 September 2022
cna496aa5f7c01.x: India's treatment coverage is 92%; 78% is the global figure.

cnb92d6a8fa755.s: Samarthak, the Indian Navy's first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel, was inducted on 16 October 2026 at:
cnb92d6a8fa755.x: Samarthak was inducted at Karwar Naval Base on 16 October 2026; it is the first of four MPVs.

cn8de6be1b62cc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NDLI-FERMI AI Tutor?
o: It was launched at IIT Kharagpur Research Park, Rajarhat, Kolkata
It runs on the National Digital Library of India
Its 'Scan and Ask' feature covers Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology
The National Digital Library of India is maintained by IIT Bombay
cn8de6be1b62cc.x: The National Digital Library of India, a Ministry of Education initiative, is maintained by IIT Kharagpur, not IIT Bombay.

cn5ed59dac807a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the first direct radio signals from Beta Pictoris b?
o: Beta Pictoris b rotates once in about 18–19 hours
MeerKAT is a precursor to the Square Kilometre Array
Beta Pictoris b is a gas giant in the constellation Pictor
They were detected by the MeerKAT array in South Africa
cn5ed59dac807a.x: Beta Pictoris b rotates in about 8–9 hours, not 18–19 hours.

cnb7d5d1d3e082.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Project VeerAI?
o: The Technology Development Board signed a ₹130 crore deal with BigEndian Semiconductors
The funding is given as equity shares from the RDI Fund
The total cost of the project is ₹260 crore
The deal was signed on 5 October 2026
cnb7d5d1d3e082.x: The funding is an Optionally Convertible Debenture from the RDI Fund, not equity shares.

cnc77b3b72d5d0.s: The first phase of the ICAR–FCI project on alternatives to chemical fumigation of stored grain costs:
cnc77b3b72d5d0.x: The first phase costs ₹3.28 crore; FCI was set up in 1965 and is based in New Delhi.

cnc516cc5cab01.s: AVNI, IIT Ropar's AI platform teaching children about plants and crops, is available in:
cnc516cc5cab01.x: AVNI is available in Hindi and English; IIT Ropar is at Rupnagar in Punjab.

cnae93a2610ca3.s: IIT Kanpur, home to the new Defence Drone Hub, was set up in 1959 with the help of:
cnae93a2610ca3.x: IIT Kanpur was set up in 1959 with a consortium of nine US universities (KIAP).

cn710465ceb27f.s: A counter-drone system such as Jwala-MK1, which destroys its target, is called a:
cn710465ceb27f.x: A hard-kill system destroys the target; a soft-kill system jams or spoofs it.

cn0e09c0e8a93c.s: Jwala-MK1, India's first private-sector micro missile, is a:
o: short-range surface-to-air missile for the counter-drone role
cn0e09c0e8a93c.x: Jwala-MK1 is a short-range counter-drone SAM; its October 2026 tests were of a solid rocket motor.

cn6c09eff2ae1b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the defence contracts signed in October 2026?
o: The ₹2,563 crore contract with NSIL is for GSAT-7C for the Indian Air Force
The ₹1,543 crore contract with BDL is for Varunastra torpedoes for the Navy
Varunastra is a lightweight torpedo developed by ISRO
cn6c09eff2ae1b.x: Varunastra is a heavyweight anti-submarine torpedo developed by DRDO, not ISRO.

cn10f29656eb90.s: Melanterite (FeSO4.7H2O), found at a Mars-analogue site in Tamil Nadu, was found at:
cn10f29656eb90.x: Melanterite was found at Neyveli; gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) was found near Tiruchirappalli.

cnec2acf526ec0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Mars-analogue study in Tamil Nadu and Mangalyaan?
o: The sites were found by the University of Madras
Mangalyaan entered Mars orbit on 24 September 2014
A Laser Raman Spectrometer was used in the study
cnec2acf526ec0.x: The Mars-analogue sites were found by the University of Kerala, not the University of Madras.

cn2bfeac146a23.s: Phobos and Deimos, the targets of JAXA's MMX mission, were discovered in 1877 by:
cn2bfeac146a23.x: Asaph Hall discovered Phobos and Deimos in 1877; MMX's rover Idefix will land on Phobos.

cnc7024c75442b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NVS-03?
o: It was launched on GSLV-F18 from the Second Launch Pad, Sriharikota
It carries payloads in the L1, L5 and C bands
It reached GTO in about 20 minutes
cnc7024c75442b.x: NVS-03 uses the L1, L5 and S bands, not the C band.

cnaac2dd35995d.s: The armour plates developed by R&DE(E), Pune, about 20% lighter, meet which NATO STANAG 4569 level?
cnaac2dd35995d.x: The plates meet NATO STANAG 4569 Level-6 and stop 30 mm armour-piercing rounds.

cn88066ee92dfd.s: IIT Madras's Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre, set up in 2022, is led by:
cn88066ee92dfd.x: Prof Mohanasankar Sivaprakasam leads the centre, which maps human brains from the foetal stage to age 85.

cnabc7acbf750b.s: Raksha Expo-2026, part of the Invest Telangana Global Summit, will be held on:
cnabc7acbf750b.x: Raksha Expo-2026 runs 7–9 December 2026, with its air show on 9 December.

cnafb0dfd68412.s: SpaDeX, whose two satellites re-entered in October 2026, was launched on 30 December 2024 by:
cnafb0dfd68412.x: SpaDeX was launched on PSLV-C60; SpaDeX-A re-entered over the South Pacific and SpaDeX-B over the North Atlantic.

cn6070ff83c76f.s: IIT Bombay's low-cost device for anaemia and sickle cell works on the principle that viscous blood:
cn6070ff83c76f.x: Viscous blood spreads shorter when smeared, which the device uses.

cn9d419f28b23c.s: Tejas, which took part in 'Wings Over Ganga' at Varanasi, is designed by ADA and built by:
cn9d419f28b23c.x: Tejas is designed by ADA and built by HAL; Su-30MKI and LCH Prachand also flew at Namo Ghat.

cn10aecdca4c1a.s: India's SSLV launch centre at Kulasekarapattinam is in which district of Tamil Nadu?
cn10aecdca4c1a.x: Kulasekarapattinam is in Thoothukudi district; Sriharikota now has two launch pads.

cnc9bcd1d6388f.s: Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessels (NGOPVs) for the Navy are being built by:
cnc9bcd1d6388f.x: NGOPVs are built by Goa Shipyard Limited and GRSE; 'Srishti' was launched by Sandeepa Sahay.

cn0a0676fd48e4.s: The 'Lumina' simulation of the early universe models the reionization of:
cn0a0676fd48e4.x: Lumina models hydrogen and helium reionization; it is by the Center for Astrophysics Harvard & Smithsonian, MIT and Harvard.

cn50179f172ff9.s: CSIR, which organised ESTIC 2026, was set up on 26 September:
cn50179f172ff9.x: CSIR was set up on 26 September 1942; ESTIC 2026 had 12 focus areas.

cncea19c02a47e.s: The Triassic, from which the Gerrothorax maritimus fossils date, is which period of the Mesozoic era?
o: It is not a Mesozoic period
cncea19c02a47e.x: The Triassic is the first period of the Mesozoic; the fossils are about 237 million years old (Late Triassic).

cn033946124cbb.s: How many private space firms were selected under IN-SPACe AI INSPIRED?
cn033946124cbb.x: Six firms were selected, each with a seed grant of up to ₹1 crore.

cn635984c454c8.s: Google's Project Suncatcher showed the first successful operation in space of a:
cn635984c454c8.x: Project Suncatcher (Google, Mountain View) showed the first successful operation of a data-centre-class AI chip in space.

cnd86e96ead07b.s: NASA's BioSentinel was launched on 16 November 2022 as one of 10 CubeSats of:
cnd86e96ead07b.x: BioSentinel flew on SLS as one of 10 CubeSats of Artemis I; its DNA-damage study failed as the yeast did not grow.

cn2f351fafc460.s: About how many tests had been done for Gaganyaan by November 2026?
cn2f351fafc460.x: About 8,000 tests have been done for Gaganyaan; Chandrayaan-4 is targeted for 2028.

cnf31b75c61a0e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's first public-sector proton therapy centre in Assam?
o: Assam signed an MoU with Belgium's Ion Beam Applications on 31 October 2026
It will be India's third proton therapy centre
The ₹600 crore project includes a ₹315 crore loan from the Asian Development Bank
cnf31b75c61a0e.x: The ₹315 crore loan is from the World Bank, not the Asian Development Bank.

cn7f175628ef30.s: Pralay, tested on 4 November 2026, is a:
cn7f175628ef30.x: Pralay is a solid-fuelled short-range surface-to-surface quasi-ballistic missile; it hit two targets about 500 km away.

cn3e4e3f2b9ab7.s: The IIT Delhi–DRDO fire protection suit can withstand temperatures up to:
cn3e4e3f2b9ab7.x: The suit withstands up to 1,300°C and costs ₹30,000–40,000; imported suits cost ₹1–3 lakh.

cnd8326b92195d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Kishtwar seismological observatory and related facts?
o: Its data goes to the National Centre for Seismology
The Richter scale measures the intensity of an earthquake
Jammu and Kashmir now has four seismological observatories
The National Centre for Seismology is under MoES
cnd8326b92195d.x: The Richter scale measures magnitude; the Modified Mercalli scale measures intensity.

ca111446409bd1.s: The Access and Understanding phase of NASA's Moon Base programme runs till:
ca111446409bd1.x: The Access and Understanding phase runs till 2029; India signed the Artemis Accords in 2023 as the 27th country.

cac0b685b61d43.s: Exercise Udara Shakti 2026 was conducted between India and:
cac0b685b61d43.x: Udara Shakti 2026 was an India–Malaysia exercise; Maitree-XV was with Thailand.

cad273e4050c71.s: Under India's space-sector FDI norms, how much FDI is allowed through the automatic route in satellite manufacturing and operations?
cad273e4050c71.x: Satellite manufacturing and operations allow 74% automatic FDI; launch vehicles and spaceports 49%.

ca466b8dd25a37.s: Vikram-I, India's first private orbital rocket launch from Indian soil, lifted off on 18 July 2026 from:
ca466b8dd25a37.x: Vikram-I lifted off from SDSC Sriharikota on 18 July 2026.

ca1434af146eeb.s: Which payload on Vikram-I was a German technology demonstration?
ca1434af146eeb.x: DCUBED was the German tech demonstration; SCOPE was Skyroot's flight-data satellite and Cosmoserve Embrace the debris-capture arm.

ca6b8c0de2a45a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's digital public infrastructure?
o: UPI and RuPay are part of India's DPI
UPI money is a liability of the RBI
The Digital Rupee is a liability of the RBI
DigiLocker and ONDC are part of India's DPI
ca6b8c0de2a45a.x: UPI money is a bank's deposit liability; only the Digital Rupee is an RBI liability.

ca97392bbc32e0.s: How many Jaguar squadrons does the Indian Air Force operate (at Ambala, Gorakhpur and Jamnagar)?
ca97392bbc32e0.x: The IAF has 6 Jaguar squadrons; India is to acquire 9 retired UK Jaguars for spares.

cad705897ab9b0.s: ICGS Akshay, commissioned at Goa Shipyard on 27 June 2026, is a:
cad705897ab9b0.x: ICGS Akshay is a Fast Patrol Vessel; H-561 is the ICG's first indigenous Air Cushion Vehicle.

ca97f6aa0a5d29.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about IMAT-05?
o: It was an Integrated Main Parachute Airdrop Test for Gaganyaan
It was conducted at the ADRDE drop zone in Sheopur
The parachute tested is for G1, the first crewed Gaganyaan mission
ca97f6aa0a5d29.x: G1 is the first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission, not a crewed one.

ca9db4afd2e542.s: India's Venus Orbiter Mission, which will use aerobraking, is targeted for:
ca9db4afd2e542.x: The Venus Orbiter Mission is targeted for March 2028.

ca6ded9586032d.s: In the TRISHNA mission, the thermal infrared (TIR) instrument is provided by:
ca6ded9586032d.x: CNES provides the TIR instrument and ISRO the VNIR-SWIR instrument; launch is due in 2027.

cae388696f6561.s: India's first multi-wavelength space observatory is:
cae388696f6561.x: AstroSat is India's first multi-wavelength observatory; XPoSat is for X-ray astronomy.

cac72b6d91300e.s: NSTL Visakhapatnam transferred LM2500 gas-turbine technology in August 2026 to:
cac72b6d91300e.x: The LM2500 technology went to Vertex Engineering Systems, Hyderabad, not Bharat Dynamics Ltd.

caaa23f215901b.s: The Defence Acquisition Council is chaired by the:
caaa23f215901b.x: The DAC is chaired by the Defence Minister; the Defence Testing Portal opens facilities of 24 DRDO labs.

ca0d87a773824a.s: What is the power output of India's first hydrogen train?
ca0d87a773824a.x: The train has 2,400 kW (about 3,200 hp), not 3,200 kW.

ca769035850691.s: NIDAR 2.0, using the indigenous VEGA RISC-V processor, was launched by MeitY with:
ca769035850691.x: NIDAR 2.0 was launched by MeitY with the Drone Federation of India; VEGA was developed under DIR-V.

cac85df40149d7.s: The low-cost rechargeable Zinc-Air battery reported in July 2026 was developed by:
cac85df40149d7.x: Dr S. Devaraj of SASTRA developed the Zinc-Air battery; Placenta-on-Chip is by IIT Bombay and ICMR-NIRRCH.

ca53c7db468cd9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Aadhaar-linked platforms in 2026?
o: Direct Benefit Transfer exceeded ₹51 lakh crore
Aadhaar authenticated 100% of the Public Distribution System
DigiLocker is part of India's digital public infrastructure
ca53c7db468cd9.x: PDS authentication through Aadhaar was over 98%, not 100%.

ca36786ef7e79d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Gnani Artha sovereign AI stack?
o: It aims to ensure data sovereignty
It was launched in New Delhi on 28 August 2026
It aims to develop an indigenous sovereign AI stack and LLMs
It was launched by the Prime Minister
ca36786ef7e79d.x: Gnani Artha was launched by Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan, not the Prime Minister.

ca72d20b364d71.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's electric mobility?
o: The India Electric Mobility Index was released by the Ministry of Heavy Industries
The India Electric Mobility Index was released in August 2025
Transport contributes about 9% of India's emissions
ca72d20b364d71.x: The India Electric Mobility Index was released by NITI Aayog, not the Ministry of Heavy Industries.

ca6ac42cfdd821.s: The 7th ICG–Vietnam Coast Guard High-Level Meeting (25 August 2026) was held at:
ca6ac42cfdd821.x: The meeting was held at Chennai; the ICG was established on 1 February 1977.

ca7079dd968a17.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's digital and financial inclusion platforms?
o: Jan Dhan accounts rose to 57.78 crore by February 2026
Jan Dhan deposits stood at ₹2.94 lakh crore
The Global DPI Repository was launched in February 2026
India Stack Global was launched during India's G20 Presidency
ca7079dd968a17.x: India Stack Global and the Global DPI Repository were launched during India's G20 Presidency, not in February 2026.

caa229483d2f32.s: India left the Fifth Generation Fighter Aircraft (FGFA) programme with Russia in:
caa229483d2f32.x: India left FGFA in 2021; Russia offered the Su-57 at SPIEF 2026.

ca6770699200d6.s: Sanshodhak, commissioned at Kolkata on 21 June 2026, is India's:
ca6770699200d6.x: Sanshodhak is the 4th large survey vessel; Dunagiri is the 5th P-17A frigate and Agray the 4th Arnala-class ASW-SWC.

cad36a36491a74.s: Vepdegestrant, the world's first PROTAC drug for advanced breast cancer, was approved by:
cad36a36491a74.x: Vepdegestrant was approved by the US FDA, not the DCGI.

ca24d0fb334f1d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Nipah preparedness in Kerala?
o: Nipah is not a WHO priority pathogen
The One Health Centre for Nipah Research and Resilience is at Kozhikode
The One Health Centre was set up in 2023
It has more than 2.5 lakh surveillance volunteers
ca24d0fb334f1d.x: Nipah is a WHO priority pathogen and on Kerala's watch-list.

caa31b9867cf87.s: PowerBank-50, India's first satellite battery with 'Flight Heritage', was developed by:
caa31b9867cf87.x: PowerBank-50 was developed by TakeMe2Space of Hyderabad, not a Bengaluru firm.

ca0e4497bbf342.s: IIT Bombay's low-cost green hydrogen catalyst avoids platinum and iridium and instead uses:
ca0e4497bbf342.x: The catalyst uses cobalt, nickel, phosphate and graphite, with no platinum or iridium.

ca650a023ba2d5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Puga Valley geothermal project?
o: It is a 1 MW demonstration-scale project
It is linked to Carbon-Neutral Ladakh
ca650a023ba2d5.x: The Puga Valley project was executed by the ONGC Energy Centre, not NTPC.

ca3b6004d1c776.s: India's first hydrogen train uses which fuel-cell technology?
ca3b6004d1c776.x: The train uses PEM fuel cells, needs no overhead wires and gives out only water vapour.

ca9cb60b2776ce.s: CODENE, India's first Centre of Design Engineering for Nuclear Energy, is located at:
ca9cb60b2776ce.x: CODENE is at IIT Hyderabad, set up with CEEPL and Dassault Systèmes.

ca8d63a575a252.s: The IndiaAI Mission, approved in 2024 under MeitY, has an outlay of:
ca8d63a575a252.x: The IndiaAI Mission has an outlay of ₹10,371.92 crore; ₹18,100 crore is PLI-ACC and ₹10,900 crore PM E-DRIVE.

caf567b797f72b.s: LUPEX (Chandrayaan-5) is a joint lunar mission of ISRO with:
caf567b797f72b.x: LUPEX is with Japan's JAXA; TRISHNA is with France and NISAR with NASA.

ca9bf7ab79e082.s: The 100% indigenised AK-203 prototype 'Sher' uses which calibre?
ca9bf7ab79e082.x: Sher uses 7.62×39 mm and was tested by Indo-Russian Rifles; the Ugram rifle is 7.62×51 mm.

ca606dcace18f2.s: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders (MDL) was established in:
ca606dcace18f2.x: MDL dates to 1934; HSL 1941, Goa Shipyard 1957 and Cochin Shipyard 1972.

ca2c9b0c2727b4.s: Besides indigenous 4G and spectrum research, the BSNL–IIT Kanpur MoU covers:
ca2c9b0c2727b4.x: The MoU covers D2M broadcasting, indigenous 4G and spectrum research.

new.s: SHANTI (2026), India's newest maritime framework, focuses on cooperative maritime security in the:

new.s: MAHASAGAR, announced in 2025, extends India's maritime vision to the:
new.x: SAGAR (2015) = IOR; MAHASAGAR (2025) = Global South; SHANTI (2026) = Bay of Bengal.

new.s: How many pillars does the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI), launched at the East Asia Summit in Bangkok in 2019, have?
new.x: The IPOI has 7 pillars.

new.s: India's Act East Policy meets which policy of Thailand?
new.x: India's Act East meets Thailand's 'Act West'; India's own Gulf policy is Link West.

new.s: Raksha, released by the Defence Ministry on 3 September 2026, is a 10-year framework for:
new.x: Raksha is the Defence Ministry's 10-year framework for defence diplomacy.

new.x: MAHASAGAR dates to 2025; SHANTI is the 2026 framework.

new.s: In July 2025, who became the first Indian Prime Minister to be chief guest at the Maldives Independence Day (60 years)?
new.x: Modi was the first Indian PM chief guest at the Maldives' 60th Independence Day and inaugurated the MoD building in Male.

new.s: The 23rd India–Russia Annual Summit was held at:
new.x: The 23rd India–Russia Annual Summit was in New Delhi.

new.s: The 3rd India–Australia Annual Summit was held at:
new.x: The 3rd India–Australia Annual Summit was in Melbourne.

new.x: The inaugural Defence Strategic Dialogue was with New Zealand; India has 2+2 formats with Japan, Australia and Brazil.

new.x: The Dialogue, set up in 2010, held six rounds (2011–2019) and was suspended after Galwan (2020).

new.x: I2U2 = India, Israel, UAE and the US.

new.s: IMT-TRILAT is a grouping of India with:
new.x: IMT-TRILAT = India, Tanzania and Mozambique.

new.s: Which country chairs the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation for 2026–27?
new.x: Pakistan, not India, chairs the SCO for 2026–27.

new.s: How many members does BRICS have?

new.s: The secretariat of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) is at:
new.x: IORA (founded 1997) has its secretariat at Ebène, Mauritius.

new.x: India chairs IORA for 2025–27, after Sri Lanka (2023–25).

new.x: Hambantota is in Sri Lanka.

new.x: Chabahar is in Iran (India), Gwadar in Pakistan (China), Hambantota in Sri Lanka and Agalega in Mauritius.

new.x: IPGL signed the 10-year contract on 13 May 2024.

new.s: The first MILAN multilateral naval exercise was held in 1995 at:

new.x: MILAN 2024 was the 12th edition; MILAN 2026 was the 13th.

new.x: Garuda is the India–France air exercise; Varuna is naval.

new.s: Exercise Pragati (2026), involving the Indian Army and 11 partner countries, was held in:
new.x: Exercise Pragati 2026 was held in Meghalaya.

new.x: The 2nd Veer Guardian was held at Jodhpur in September 2026.

new.x: Cyclone = Egypt (Special Forces); Desert Cyclone = UAE (Army).

new.x: Desert Cyclone is with the UAE Army; Cyclone is with Egypt.

new.s: Surya Kiran is a joint army exercise between India and:
new.x: Surya Kiran is with Nepal (since 2011), not Bhutan.

new.x: Ekuverin is with the Maldives Army; Garuda Shakti is Indonesia, Desert Cyclone UAE and Surya Kiran Nepal.

new.s: The 13th edition of Exercise Khanjar (February 2026) was held at:
new.x: Khanjar-13 with Kyrgyzstan was held at Missamari, Assam.

new.s: Yudh Abhyas 2026, held in Uttarakhand and Rajasthan at the same time, was which edition?
new.x: Yudh Abhyas (since 2004) had its 22nd edition in September 2026.

new.s: How many Rafale-M jets for the Navy did India contract in April 2025?
new.x: 26 Rafale-M (Navy, 2025); 36 Rafale (IAF, 2016); 114 MRFA (AoN 2026).

new.s: Under the ₹1,943 crore lease of August 2026, India leased how many MQ-9B Sea Guardian drones for 30 months?
new.x: India leased 2 MQ-9B drones for 30 months for ₹1,943 crore.

new.s: The MQ-9B Sea Guardian HALE drone is made by:
new.x: The MQ-9B is made by US firm General Atomics.

new.s: What is the range of the S-400 Triumf air-defence system used in Operation Sindoor?
new.x: The Russian S-400 has a range of 400 km.

new.s: How many CQB carbines were ordered from Bharat Forge and PLR?
new.x: 4.25 lakh CQB carbines were ordered in a ₹4,666 crore package.

new.s: In February 2026, the DAC gave AoN for how many more P-8I maritime patrol aircraft?
new.x: The DAC cleared 6 more P-8I aircraft (US) in February 2026.

new.s: India's Mission Sudarshan Chakra multi-layer defence shield is modelled on:
new.x: Mission Sudarshan Chakra is modelled on Israel's Iron Dome; the S-400 called 'Sudarshan Chakra' is Russian.

new.s: Operation Brahma provided relief to which country after the 28 March 2025 earthquake?
new.x: Operation Brahma was India's relief to Myanmar after the magnitude 7.7 quake.

new.s: Operation Sindhu was launched by India for:
o: relief to Myanmar after an earthquake
evacuation of Indians from Iran and West Asia
relief to Sri Lanka after a cyclone
new.x: Sindhu = evacuation; Brahma = Myanmar; Sagar Bandhu = Sri Lanka; Urja Suraksha = energy shipping.

new.s: Operation Sagar Bandhu was India's assistance to which country after Cyclone Ditwah?
new.x: Sagar Bandhu helped Sri Lanka after Cyclone Ditwah.

new.s: Operation Southern Spear, against narco-terrorism in the Caribbean, is conducted by:
new.x: Southern Spear is a US operation in the Caribbean.

new.s: Operation Amistad of India is associated with:
new.x: Amistad = Venezuela; Brahma = Myanmar; Sagar Bandhu = Sri Lanka.

new.s: Who was sworn in as Prime Minister of Bangladesh on 17 February 2026?
new.x: Tarique Rahman became PM after the BNP's landslide in the 12 February 2026 election.

new.s: Balendra (Balen) Shah was sworn in as Prime Minister of Nepal in March 2026 after a win by:
new.x: The Rastriya Swatantra Party won 182 of 275 seats; Balen Shah was sworn in on 27 March 2026.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about elections in India's neighbourhood in 2026:
1. The BNP won Bangladesh's 12 February election in a landslide.
2. The Rastriya Swatantra Party won 182 of 275 seats in Nepal.
3. Tarique Rahman became Prime Minister of Nepal.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; Tarique Rahman became PM of Bangladesh, while Balen Shah became PM of Nepal.

new.s: The Falklands dispute is between the United Kingdom and:
new.x: The Falklands are disputed between the UK and Argentina.

new.s: The 2026 West Asia war, which led to the Hormuz blockade, began on:
new.x: The war began on 28 February 2026; a US–Iran MoU followed in June 2026.

new.s: In August 2026, India standardised 27 Arunachal Pradesh place names on the maps of:
new.x: The 27 names, such as Longju and Thag La, were standardised on Survey of India maps in response to China's renaming.

new.s: Under the Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project, Indian cargo reaches Mizoram via which port of Myanmar?
new.x: Kaladan runs from Indian east-coast ports to Sittwe port, by river to Paletwa, then by road to Mizoram.

new.s: The 720 MW Mangdechhu hydropower project, inaugurated in August 2019, is in:
new.x: Mangdechhu (720 MW) is an India-assisted project in Bhutan.

new.s: India's forward naval facility at Agalega is in:
new.x: Agalega is in Mauritius.

new.x: The MoD building in Male, Maldives, was inaugurated in July 2025.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (India-assisted project – host country) is correctly matched?
new.x: Agalega is in Mauritius; Mangdechhu is in Bhutan, Kaladan in Myanmar and Chabahar in Iran.

new.s: Which blood group is called the universal donor?
new.x: O-negative red cells carry no A, B or Rh antigens, so it is the universal donor.

new.s: Which blood group is called the universal recipient?
new.x: AB-positive has no anti-A or anti-B antibodies, so it is the universal recipient.

new.s: The ABO blood group system was discovered by:
new.x: Karl Landsteiner discovered the ABO groups and won the Nobel Prize in 1930.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about blood groups:
1. Blood with the RhD antigen is Rh-positive.
2. O-negative red cells carry no A, B or Rh antigens.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: RhD present = Rh-positive, and O-negative lacks A, B and Rh antigens.

new.s: CERVAVAC, India's first indigenous quadrivalent HPV vaccine, covers which HPV types?
new.x: CERVAVAC (Serum Institute) covers HPV 6, 11, 16 and 18; types 16 and 18 cause about 70% of cervical cancers.

new.s: Under the WHO 90–70–90 targets for 2030, 90% of girls are to be vaccinated against HPV by the age of:
new.x: The target is 90% of girls vaccinated by 15, 70% of women screened at 35 and 45, and 90% treated.

new.s: The National Quantum Mission, approved in 2023, has an outlay of:
new.x: NQM has ₹6,003.65 crore for 2023–24 to 2030–31; ₹4,500 crore is the NSM outlay.

new.s: By 2024, how many semiconductor units had been approved under ISM 1.0?
new.x: ISM 1.0 had approved 4 units by 2024; the total later reached 12.

new.s: Mission Mausam, approved in September 2024, has an outlay of:
new.x: Mission Mausam has ₹2,000 crore for 2 years and is run by IMD, IITM and NCMRWF.

new.s: GSLV-F17 placed EOS-05 initially into a:
new.x: EOS-05 was placed in a Sub-GTO, not directly in GEO.

new.s: BrahMos Aerospace was set up in 1998 as a joint venture of DRDO and:
new.x: BrahMos is a JV of DRDO and Russia's NPO Mashinostroyenia; its name joins Brahmaputra and Moskva.

new.s: People of which blood group can receive red cells of all ABO groups, as they have no anti-A or anti-B antibodies?
new.x: AB-positive is the universal recipient.

new.s: Karl Landsteiner, who discovered the ABO blood groups, won the Nobel Prize in:
new.x: Landsteiner received the Nobel Prize in 1930.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about blood groups:
1. O-negative is the universal donor.
2. Rh-negative blood carries the RhD antigen.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only 1 is correct: Rh-negative blood lacks the RhD antigen.

new.s: The world's first hydrogen passenger train was:
new.x: The world's first hydrogen passenger train was Alstom's Coradia iLint (Germany, 2018), not India's.

new.s: The National Green Hydrogen Mission (January 2023) is implemented by:
o: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
new.x: The Mission (₹19,744 crore) is under MNRE, not DST or DPIIT.

new.s: The National Green Hydrogen Mission has an outlay of:
new.x: The Mission has ₹19,744 crore and targets 5 MMT a year by 2030.

new.s: Ugram, the indigenous assault rifle by DRDO ARDE and Dvipa Defence, uses which calibre?
new.x: Ugram is 7.62×51 mm; the AK-203 Sher is 7.62×39 mm.

new.x: RudraM-II is an anti-radiation air-to-surface missile of up to 300 km, to replace the Kh-31.

new.s: The Kusha LR-SAM, first tested on 23 July 2026, is described as India's answer to:
new.x: Kusha is India's answer to the S-400.

new.s: Who was the first foreign buyer of BrahMos (2022)?
new.x: The Philippines was the first buyer (2022); Vietnam's deal was confirmed in 2026.

new.s: India's first public–private JV in defence avionics is:
new.x: Samtel HAL Display Systems (SHDS), Gurugram, is the first public–private defence avionics JV.

new.x: Vikram-S (2022) was sub-orbital; Vikram-1 (2026) is orbital.

new.x: Chandrayaan-3 made India the 4th country to soft-land, after the US, Russia and China.

new.s: INS Malvan, commissioned on 22 July 2026, is a:
new.x: INS Malvan is the second Mahe-class ASW SWC, built by Cochin Shipyard.
